data.name: Mukhlisi
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'kh-l-s', meaning 'to reside' or 'to dwell'. In Islamic history, it is said that the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) referred to the early Muslims as 'Mukhalloqoon' – the dwellers of heaven. Mukhlisi is a powerful name for a boy, evoking a sense of stability, rootedness, and connection to the divine.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rooted in faith and connected to the divine.
data.numerology_meaning: Individuals with the name Mukhlisi are natural leaders and problem-solvers. They have a strong sense of purpose and are deeply connected to their faith and values.

in_arabic.name: مخليص
in_arabic.meaning: الحق المطلق، الذي يخلص الناس من الخطايا
in_arabic.long_meaning: مخليص هو اسم عربي يرمز إلى الحق المطلق، الذي يخلص الناس من الخطايا وأعمال الشيطان، ويجعل قلوبهم خالية من الشك وأفكارهم تامة في الدين، ويهدد الأعداء من الجنس البشري، ويفرق بين الخير والشَرْك، ويعرف الحق من الباطل، ويجعلهم يشعرون بالخوف من الله، ويكونون مهيّأين للجنة من النار، ويُعطيهم العلم والمعرفة، ويُستأذن في الأمر، ويُجيب في الدعاء، ويكون كلمته حقاً وقولاً.

in_english.name: Mukhlisi
in_english.long_meaning: Mukhlisi is a name that refers to someone who is purified, true, honest, innocent, and spotless. The name is derived from the Arabic root KHL (خ-ل), which means to cleanse, purify, or rectify. In Islamic tradition, the name Mukhlisi is associated with one who has been cleansed of sin and has been made pure and spotless. The name is also related to the Arabic word khilas (خلص), which means purification or rectification.

He is known for his contributions to the development of Chishti Sufism and for his influence on the works of other Sufi poets such as Amir Khusrow.
